selection: Source frozen winners plus optional equal combination; 0.45 full-v39 historical valid gain +0.55 CV proxy mean -0.04 CV SD. Eligibility valid>0.0002, CV mean>0, objective>0.0005; individual fold declines allowed.
limitations: Historical validation reused, multiple-source selection bias. CV is a proxy rather than full historical ensemble OOF. Conditional other-task assays. Official formula unknown; no guaranteed platform gain.
